System_Information.Title: Illustrative DAC breakthrough - 400 ppm CO2 on Lewatit VP OC 1065
System_Information.Description: ILLUSTRATIVE, not a validated reproduction. Isothermal breakthrough of 400 ppm CO2 in N2 on the library adsorbent Lewatit VP OC 1065, with the dual-rate LDF (fast and slow site) and the series-resistance coefficient (film, macropore and micropore resistances with the capacity factor). Rate parameters are round numbers chosen to show an early front and a slow tail.
System_Information.Author: Skarstrom examples
